title.zh: 将伊洛伊洛省卡巴纳图安市镇蒂尼奥-安小学的名称变更为Doroteo Lujan小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Tinio-an Elementary School in the Municipality of Cabanatuan, Province of Iloilo, to Doroteo Lujan Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Tinio-an Elementary School in the Municipality of Cabanatuan, Province of Iloilo, to Doroteo Lujan Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Tinio-an tại Thị trấn Cabanatuan, Tỉnh Iloilo thành Trường tiểu học Doroteo Lujan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Tinio-an ในเทศบาล Cabanatuan, จังหวัด Iloilo เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Doroteo Lujan
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Tinio-an di Kotamadya Cabanatuan, Provinsi Iloilo menjadi Sekolah Dasar Doroteo Lujan
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Tinio-an di Perbandaran Cabanatuan, Wilayah Iloilo menjadi Sekolah Rendah Doroteo Lujan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1962/ra_3505_1962.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Tinio-an Elementary School in the Municipality of Cabanatuan, Province of Iloilo, is changed to Doroteo Lujan Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1962.
